units.function: BudgetService tests for Company, project and Agent spend policies, soft/hard incidents, approval creation, pause/cancellation, invocation release gates, budget raise/resume, ledger reconciliation, overview projection and telemetry redaction.
units.dependencyDirection: Immutable-ish cost events and active policies enter BudgetService; it aggregates observed spend, writes incidents and budget-override approvals, pauses Company/project/Agent records, calls a runtime cancellation boundary and logs sanitized activity. Invocation paths query the same service before starting work, while board incident resolution updates policy/budget and resumes only budget-owned pauses.
units.keyDataModels: Budget policy scope/metric/window/amount/warn percent/hard-stop flags, CostEvent provider/model/tokens/cents/time, soft/hard incident and observed/limit/window, budget_override_required Approval, Company/project/Agent pause reason/time, invocation block, overview utilization and decision note/user.
units.lifecycle: Each cost event reevaluates applicable policies against live ledger totals. Crossing warning creates one soft incident per window; crossing hard resolves soft state, creates one hard incident plus pending override Approval, marks the scope budget-paused and cancels work. New invocations are blocked by either pause state or still-exceeded live policy. Resolution rejects a limit not above current spend, approves the incident, raises the policy/Company monthly budget and clears only budget-owned pause; overview reconciles live ledger values.
units.testAssessment: Seven focused unit/integration cases cover reactive enforcement, release-gate checks independent of pause lag, manual-versus-budget pause reason, live spend at resolution, Company budget sync, one-incident idempotency, Agent/project cancellation, ledger-derived overview and telemetry redaction. Gaps include cost-event dedup/idempotency key, transaction/outbox around incident/approval/pause/cancel, cancellation failure/retry, concurrent spend/raises, reservations before expensive actions, delayed/estimated/negative/refund costs, currency/FX, hierarchical policy precedence, window boundaries/timezones, authorization/separation of duties, maximum override and evidence tying the Approval to exact policy/action digest.
units.designRationale: Make spend governance an enforceable backend release gate rather than a dashboard warning, preserve a human override path, stop already-running work and reconcile decisions against the authoritative cost ledger instead of stale incident snapshots.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs cost and resource governance across heterogeneous models/Agents where an accountable human approves exceptional spend and the system can prove which work was stopped, resumed and charged.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the ledger-derived live check, scope hierarchy, soft/hard incident split, budget-owned pause reason, pre-invocation block, sanitized telemetry and raise-above-observed rule. Add budget reservations/estimated upper bounds before execution, currency and provider billing normalization, immutable policy/action digest, risk-based approver separation, transaction + outbox for cancel/resume, Connector cancellation receipts and reconciliation for late/refunded costs.
units.responsibilityConflict: Enforcement is primarily reactive after a CostEvent, so spend can exceed the limit before cancellation. The service API accepts a board-user id to approve and raise without proving role, separation of duties or maximum authority. Repeated hard evaluation avoids duplicate incidents but calls cancellation twice, and no durable side-effect receipt proves every affected Run stopped before later spend.
